description: Enable auto-exposure. Optional priority 'global' | 'face' selects the metering region (face-priority meters for a detected face). Uses the proprietary V3 frame protocol (CAM_SET_EXPOSURE_TINY2, which carries mode and value in one command) because the standard UVC/IAMCameraControl V4L2 path is a stub on the Tiny 2.
name: obsbot_image_exposure_auto
